sn35.103:1.1: udako sudaṃ bhikkhave rāmaputto evaṃ vācaṃ bhāsati
sn35.103:1.6: taṃ kho panetaṃ bhikkhave udako rāmaputto avedagūyeva samāno vedagūsmīti bhāsati apabbajiyeva samāno pabbajismīti bhāsati apalikhataṃyeva gaṇḍamūlaṃ palikhataṃ me gaṇḍamūlanti bhāsati.
sn35.103:1.7: atha kho taṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu sammā vadamāno vadeyya
sn35.103:2.2: yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhu channaṃ phassāyatanānaṃ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
sn35.103:2.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu vedagū hoti.
sn35.103:3.2: yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhu channaṃ phassāyatanānaṃ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ viditvā anupādā vimutto hoti.
sn35.103:3.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu pabbaji hoti.
sn35.103:4.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhuno ca apalikhataṃ gaṇḍamūlaṃ palikhataṃ hoti.
sn35.103:4.2: gaṇḍoti kho bhikkhave imassetaṃ cātummahābhūtikassa kāyassa adhivacanaṃ mātāpettikasambhavassa odanakummāsūpacayassa aniccucchādanaparimaddanabhedanaviddhaṃsanadhammassa.
sn35.103:4.4: yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno taṇhā pahīnā hoti ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvaṅkatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
sn35.103:4.5: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno apalikhitaṃ gaṇḍamūlaṃ palikhitaṃ hoti.
sn35.103:5.1: udako sudaṃ bhikkhave rāmaputto evaṃ vācaṃ bhāsati
sn35.103:5.6: taṃ kho panetaṃ bhikkhave udako rāmaputto avedagū yeva samāno vedagūsmīti bhāsati apabbaji yeva samāno pabbajismīti bhāsati apalikhataññeva gaṇḍamūlaṃ palikhatamme gaṇḍamūlanti bhāsati.
sn35.103:5.7: idaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu sammā vadamāno vadeyya
